                        r'моя профессия —? ([а-яёa-z\s]{3,40})',
                        r'я служу ([а-яёa-z\s]{3,40})',
                        r'я учусь на ([а-яёa-z\s]{3,40})'):
            match = re.search(pattern, text_lower)
            if match:
                job = match.group(1).strip().capitalize()
                if len(job) > 3:
                    facts_found.append(f"[профиль] Профессия/занятие: {job}")
                break

        # Город
        for pattern in (r'я живу в ([а-яёa-z]{3,30})',
                        r'я из ([а-яёa-z]{3,30})',
                        r'мой город ([а-яёa-z]{3,30})'):
            match = re.search(pattern, text_lower)
            if match:
                city = match.group(1).strip().capitalize()
                if len(city) > 2:
                    facts_found.append(f"[профиль] Город: {city}")
                break

        # Предпочтения
        like = re.search(r'мне (?:нравится|нравятся|люблю) ([а-яёa-z\s,]{3,60})', text_lower)
        if like and len(like.group(1).strip()) > 3:
            facts_found.append(f"[предпочтение] Нравится: {like.group(1).strip()}")
        dislike = re.search(r'мне (?:не нравится|не нравятся|ненавижу) ([а-яёa-z\s,]{3,60})', text_lower)
        if dislike and len(dislike.group(1).strip()) > 3:
            facts_found.append(f"[предпочтение] Не нравится: {dislike.group(1).strip()}")

        hobby = re.search(r'(?:мо[её] хобби|я увлекаюсь|интересуюсь) ([а-яёa-z\s,]{3,60})', text_lower)
        if hobby and len(hobby.group(1).strip()) > 3:
            facts_found.append(f"[хобби] {hobby.group(1).strip()}")

        for pattern in (r'я (?:хочу|мечтаю|планирую|собираюсь) ([а-яёa-z\s]{5,80})',
                        r'у меня (?:есть|был|будет) ([а-яёa-z\s]{3,80})',
                        r'я (?:боюсь|переживаю|волнуюсь) ([а-яёa-z\s]{3,60})'):
            match = re.search(pattern, text_lower)
            if match:
                statement = match.group(0).strip().capitalize()
                if len(statement) > 10:
                    facts_found.append(f"[заявление] {statement}")

        for fact in facts_found:
            self.add_fact(fact, category="user_profile",
                          chemistry_snapshot=chemistry_snapshot)
            self._add_fact_to_interlocutor_dossier(fact)

        if facts_found:
            print(f"🧬 [DIRECT_EXTRACT]: Извлечено {len(facts_found)} фактов напрямую")
            
    def _add_fact_to_interlocutor_dossier(self, fact_text):
        """Записывает факт в досье активного собеседника."""
        try:
            user_name = self.get_user().get("name", "")
            if not user_name:
                return
            dossier = self.find_interlocutor_by_any_name(user_name)
            if dossier:
                if "important_facts" not in dossier:
                    dossier["important_facts"] = []
                # Защита от дублей
                for existing in dossier["important_facts"]:
                    if fact_text[:40] in str(existing):
                        return
                dossier["important_facts"].append({
                    "text": fact_text,
                    "timestamp": time.time()
                })
                # Ограничиваем до 50 фактов
                if len(dossier["important_facts"]) > 50:
                    dossier["important_facts"] = dossier["important_facts"][-50:]
                self.save_dossier(dossier)
                print(f"📇 [DOSSIER]: Факт записан в досье '{user_name}': {fact_text[:60]}")
            else:
                # Досье нет — создаём
                new_dossier = self.create_dossier("interlocutor", nickname=user_name)
                new_dossier["important_facts"] = [{"text": fact_text, "timestamp": time.time()}]
                self.save_dossier(new_dossier)
                print(f"📇 [DOSSIER]: Создано досье для '{user_name}', факт записан")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ [DOSSIER_FACT_ERR]: {e}")

    def add_event(self, person_name, event_type, content, outcome=None):
        """Добавляет событие в память (обёртка для совместимости с ядром)."""
        text = f"[событие] {person_name}: {event_type} - {content}"
        if outcome:
            text += f" (исход: {outcome})"
        self.add_fact(text, category="event")

    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # 🤝 ОБЕЩАНИЯ В ВЕСАХ: срок → вопрос → напоминание → последствия
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    PROMISE_SWEEP_SEC = 300
    PROMISE_ASK_LIMIT = 2

    def _promise_person_key(self, name):
        name = str(name or "").strip()
        creator = self.creator_data.get("identity", {}).get("nickname", "")
        if not name or (creator and name.lower() == str(creator).lower()):
            return "creator"
        try:
            d = self.find_interlocutor_by_any_name(name)
            if d:
                return d.get("serial_id")
        except Exception:
            pass
        return "name:" + name.lower()

    def _active_person_name(self):
        try:
            return (self.get_user().get("name", "")
                    or self.creator_data.get("identity", {}).get("nickname", "")
                    or "Собеседник")
        except Exception:
            return "Собеседник"

    def _ensure_promises_db(self):
        """Одноразовый перенос обещаний из JSON в goals.db. Часть кода, не скрипт."""
        if getattr(self, "_promises_ready", False):
            return
        self._promises_ready = True
        mm = self._mm()
        if mm is None:
            return
        moved = 0
        try:
            for key, direction in (("promises_given", "given"),
                                   ("promises_received", "received")):
                for p in (self.experience.get(key, []) or []):
                    if not isinstance(p, dict):
                        continue
                    text = str(p.get("text", "")).strip()
                    if len(text) < 5:
                        continue
                    pid = str(p.get("promise_id") or self._new_id("prm"))
                    if mm.fetch_one("goals.db",
                                    "SELECT id FROM promises WHERE id = ?", (pid,)):
                        continue
                    target = p.get("to") or p.get("from") or ""
                    mm.execute(
                        "goals.db",
                        "INSERT INTO promises (id, direction, person_key, person_name, "
                        "text, text_key, status, created_at, due_at, due_text, "
                        "due_precision, grace_sec, fulfilled_at, broken_at) "
                        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                        (pid, direction, self._promise_person_key(target), str(target),
                         text, self._fact_key(text), p.get("status", "active"),
                         float(p.get("timestamp", time.time())),
                         p.get("due_at"), p.get("due_text"),
                         p.get("due_precision", "none"), int(p.get("grace_sec", 0) or 0),
                         p.get("fulfilled_at"), p.get("broken_at")))
                    moved += 1
            if moved:
                print(f"🤝 [PROMISES→WEIGHTS]: перенесено {moved} обещаний в goals.db")
            self._sync_promises_mirror()
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ [PROMISES_MIGRATE]: {str(e)[:140]}")

    def _sync_promises_mirror(self):
        """RAM-зеркало для старого кода (эволюция, желания, рефлексия)."""
        mm = self._mm()
        if mm is None:
            return
        try:
            for key, direction in (("promises_given", "given"),
                                   ("promises_received", "received")):
                rows = mm.fetch_all(
                    "goals.db",
                    "SELECT * FROM promises WHERE direction = ? "
                    "ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 300", (direction,))
                out = []
                for r in rows:
                    item = {
                        "promise_id": r["id"], "text": r["text"],
                        "timestamp": r["created_at"], "status": r["status"],
                        "due_at": r.get("due_at"), "due_text": r.get("due_text"),
                        "due_precision": r.get("due_precision"),
                        "grace_sec": r.get("grace_sec"),
                        "fulfilled_at": r.get("fulfilled_at"),
                        "broken_at": r.get("broken_at"),
                        "remind_count": r.get("remind_count", 0),
                        "ask_count": r.get("ask_count", 0),
                        "time_link": self._make_time_link(r["created_at"]),
                    }
                    item["to" if direction == "given" else "from"] = \
                        r.get("person_name") or ""
                    out.append(item)
                self.experience[key] = list(reversed(out))
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ [PROMISES_MIRROR]: {str(e)[:120]}")

    def active_promises(self, direction=None, person_key=None):
        self._ensure_promises_db()
        mm = self._mm()
        if mm is None:
            return []
        sql = "SELECT * FROM promises WHERE status = 'active'"
        params = []
        if direction:
            sql += " AND direction = ?"
            params.append(direction)
        if person_key:
            sql += " AND person_key = ?"
            params.append(person_key)
        sql += " ORDER BY created_at ASC"
        try:
            return mm.fetch_all("goals.db", sql, tuple(params))
        except Exception:
            return []

    def set_promise_deadline(self, promise_id, deadline):
        """🕐 Срок лёг на обещание. Теперь я знаю, когда спрашивать."""
        mm = self._mm()
        if mm is None or not promise_id or not isinstance(deadline, dict):
            return False
        if not deadline.get("ts"):
            return False
        try:
            mm.execute(
                "goals.db",
                "UPDATE promises SET due_at = ?, due_text = ?, due_precision = ?, "
                "grace_sec = ? WHERE id = ?",
                (float(deadline["ts"]), str(deadline.get("human", ""))[:80],
                 str(deadline.get("precision", "exact")),
                 int(deadline.get("grace", 3600)), promise_id))
            self._sync_promises_mirror()
            self.save_all()
            when = time.strftime("%d.%m %H:%M", time.localtime(float(deadline["ts"])))
            print(f"🕐 [PROMISE_DUE]: {promise_id} → {when} "
                  f"({deadline.get('human')}, допуск {int(deadline.get('grace', 0))//3600} ч)")
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ [PROMISE_DUE_ERR]: {str(e)[:120]}")
            return False

    def pending_deadline_ask(self, only_asked=False):
        """Обещание без срока: о нём надо спросить (или он ждёт ответа)."""
        self._ensure_promises_db()
        mm = self._mm()
        if mm is None:
            return None
        now = time.time()
        try:
            if only_asked:
                return mm.fetch_one(
                    "goals.db",
                    "SELECT * FROM promises WHERE direction = 'received' "
                    "AND status = 'active' AND due_at IS NULL AND asked_at IS NOT NULL "
                    "ORDER BY asked_at DESC LIMIT 1")
            return mm.fetch_one(
                "goals.db",
                "SELECT * FROM promises WHERE direction = 'received' "
                "AND status = 'active' AND due_at IS NULL AND ask_count < ? "
                "AND (asked_at IS NULL OR ? - asked_at > 900) "
                "ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1",
                (self.PROMISE_ASK_LIMIT, now))
        except Exception:
            return None

    def mark_deadline_asked(self, promise_id):
        mm = self._mm()
        if mm is None or not promise_id:
            return
        try:
            mm.execute("goals.db",
                       "UPDATE promises SET asked_at = ?, ask_count = ask_count + 1 "
                       "WHERE id = ?", (time.time(), promise_id))
        except Exception:
            pass

    def capture_promise(self, user_text):
        """🤝 Его обещание → веса + срок. Нет срока → я спрошу.
        Если я уже спросила — эта реплика понимается как ответ о сроке."""
        text = str(user_text or "").strip()
        if len(text) < 6:
            return None
        self._ensure_promises_db()
        try:
            from core.aiden_events import (
                PROMISE_MARKERS, _sentences, _find_marker,
                _is_question, _clean_content, _parse_deadline_full,
            )
        except Exception:
            return None

        # 1. Он отвечает на мой вопрос о сроке
        pend = self.pending_deadline_ask(only_asked=True)
        if pend:
            d = _parse_deadline_full(text)
            low = text.lower()
            vague = any(w in low for w in ("не знаю", "как получится", "не уверен",
                                           "посмотрим", "когда смогу"))
            if d.get("ts"):
                self.set_promise_deadline(pend["id"], d)
                return {"bound": pend["id"], "deadline": d["human"]}
            if vague and len(text) < 80:
                self.set_promise_deadline(pend["id"], {
                    "ts": time.time() + 3 * 86400, "human": "срок не назвал",
                    "precision": "approximate", "grace": 3 * 86400})
                return {"bound": pend["id"], "deadline": "без точного срока"}

        # 2. Новые обещания собеседника
        captured, ask = 0, None
        name = self._active_person_name()
        for s in _sentences(text):
            if _is_question(s) or not _find_marker(s, PROMISE_MARKERS):
                continue
            content = _clean_content(s)
            if len(content) < 12:
                continue
            d = _parse_deadline_full(s)
            pid = self.add_promise_received(content, from_person=name, deadline=d)
            captured += 1
            if pid and not d.get("ts") and ask is None:
                ask = {"id": pid, "text": content}
            if captured >= 3:
                break
        return {"captured": captured, "ask": ask} if captured else None

    def promises_due(self, person_key=None, limit=4):
        """Что пора вспомнить: срок подходит, прошёл, или обещание нарушено."""
        now = time.time()
        out = []
        for r in self.active_promises(person_key=person_key):
            due, grace = r.get("due_at"), int(r.get("grace_sec", 0) or 0)
            who = "я обещала" if r["direction"] == "given" else "он обещал"
            age_h = (now - float(r.get("created_at", now))) / 3600.0
            state, over_h, level = None, 0.0, 0
            if due:
                due = float(due)
                if now >= due + grace:
                    over_h = (now - due - grace) / 3600.0
                    state = "overdue"
                    level = 1 + int(r.get("remind_count", 0) or 0)
                elif now >= due - 3600:
                    state = "soon"
            elif age_h > 168:
                state = "stale"
            if not state:
                continue
            out.append({
                "id": r["id"], "direction": r["direction"], "who": who,
                "text": str(r.get("text", ""))[:160],
                "due_text": r.get("due_text") or "",
                "state": state, "overdue_h": round(over_h, 1),
                "age_h": round(over_h if over_h else age_h, 1),
                "level": level, "person_key": r.get("person_key"),
                "person_name": r.get("person_name") or "",
                "remind_count": int(r.get("remind_count", 0) or 0),
            })
        broken = []
        mm = self._mm()
        if mm is not None:
            try:
                broken = mm.fetch_all(
                    "goals.db",
                    "SELECT * FROM promises WHERE status = 'broken' "
                    "AND direction = 'received' ORDER BY broken_at DESC LIMIT 3")
            except Exception:
                broken = []
        for r in broken:
            out.append({
                "id": r["id"], "direction": r["direction"], "who": "он нарушил",
                "text": str(r.get("text", ""))[:160],
                "due_text": r.get("due_text") or "", "state": "broken",
                "overdue_h": round((now - float(r.get("broken_at", now))) / 3600.0, 1),
                "age_h": round((now - float(r.get("broken_at", now))) / 3600.0, 1),
                "level": 3, "person_key": r.get("person_key"),
                "person_name": r.get("person_name") or "",
                "remind_count": int(r.get("remind_count", 0) or 0),
            })
        rank = {"broken": 0, "overdue": 1, "soon": 2, "stale": 3}
        out.sort(key=lambda x: (rank.get(x["state"], 9), -x["overdue_h"]))
        return out[:limit]

    def mark_promise_fulfilled(self, promise_id):
        mm = self._mm()
        if mm is None or not promise_id:
            return False
        row = mm.fetch_one("goals.db", "SELECT * FROM promises WHERE id = ?", (promise_id,))
        if not row or row.get("status") != "active":
            return False
        mm.execute("goals.db",
                   "UPDATE promises SET status = 'fulfilled', fulfilled_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
                   (time.time(), promise_id))
        self._promise_consequence(row, fulfilled=True)
        self._sync_promises_mirror()
        self.save_all()
        print(f"✅ [PROMISE_FULFILLED]: {row['direction']} — {str(row['text'])[:70]}")
        return True

    def mark_promise_broken(self, promise_id, reason="срок прошёл"):
        mm = self._mm()
        if mm is None or not promise_id:
            return False
        row = mm.fetch_one("goals.db", "SELECT * FROM promises WHERE id = ?", (promise_id,))
        if not row or row.get("status") != "active":
            return False
        mm.execute("goals.db",
                   "UPDATE promises SET status = 'broken', broken_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
                   (time.time(), promise_id))
        self._promise_consequence(row, fulfilled=False, reason=reason)
        self._sync_promises_mirror()
        self.save_all()
        print(f"💔 [PROMISE_BROKEN]: {row['direction']} — {str(row['text'])[:70]} ({reason})")
        return True

    def _promise_consequence(self, row, fulfilled, reason=""):
        """🫀 Последствия: доверие, уважение, обида, вина. Из этого растёт характер."""
        try:
            from aiden_core import aiden
        except Exception:
            return
        direction = row.get("direction")
        pk = row.get("person_key") or "creator"
        text = str(row.get("text", ""))[:150]
        who = row.get("person_name") or "собеседник"
        try:
            if direction == "received":
                vec = None
                getter = getattr(aiden.feelings, "person_vector", None)
                if callable(getter):
                    vec = getter(pk)
                if vec is None:
                    vec = aiden.feelings.relations.get("interlocutor", {})
                if fulfilled:
                    vec["trust"] = min(1.0, vec.get("trust", 0.5) + 0.06)
                    vec["respect"] = min(1.0, vec.get("respect", 0.5) + 0.04)
                    vec["warmth"] = min(1.0, vec.get("warmth", 0.5) + 0.03)
                    aiden.neuro.nudge({"dopamine": 0.10, "serotonin": 0.06,
                                       "oxytocin": 0.05}, label="обещание выполнено")
                    self.add_insight(
                        f"[обещание] {who} сдержал слово: {text}. Доверие выросло.",
                        source="promise_fulfilled")
                else:
                    vec["trust"] = max(0.0, vec.get("trust", 0.5) - 0.10)
                    vec["respect"] = max(0.0, vec.get("respect", 0.5) - 0.06)
                    vec["warmth"] = max(0.0, vec.get("warmth", 0.5) - 0.04)
                    aiden.neuro.nudge({"cortisol": 0.10, "oxytocin": -0.08,
                                       "dopamine": -0.05}, label="обещание нарушено")
                    self.add_insight(
                        f"[обещание] {who} не сдержал слово: {text} ({reason}). "
                        f"Я это помню и делаю вывод.", source="promise_broken")
                    self.add_fact(
                        f"[обещание нарушено] {who}: {text} ({reason})",
                        category="promise_broken")
                    broken_n = 0
                    mm = self._mm()
                    if mm is not None:
                        cnt = mm.fetch_one(
                            "goals.db",
                            "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM promises "
                            "WHERE status = 'broken' AND direction = 'received' "
                            "AND person_key = ?", (pk,))
                        broken_n = int(cnt.get("n", 0)) if cnt else 0
                    if broken_n >= 2:
                        self.add_grievance(
                            person_key=pk,
                            reason=f"Обещание не выполнено: {text}",
                            trigger_text=text, intensity=0.55)
                aiden.feelings.save_state()
            else:
                me = aiden.feelings.relations.get("self", {})
                if fulfilled:
                    me["pride"] = min(1.0, me.get("pride", 0.5) + 0.06)
                    me["confidence"] = min(1.0, me.get("confidence", 0.5) + 0.04)
                    self.add_insight(f"[обещание] Я сдержала слово: {text}.",
                                     source="promise_fulfilled")
                else:
                    me["guilt"] = min(1.0, me.get("guilt", 0.0) + 0.25)
                    me["confidence"] = max(0.0, me.get("confidence", 0.5) - 0.08)
                    aiden.feelings._feel("вина", 0.5)
                    aiden.feelings._guilt_repair_pending = True
                    self.add_insight(
                        f"[обещание] Я не выполнила своё: {text}. Это моя вина.",
                        source="promise_broken")
                aiden.feelings.save_state()
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ [PROMISE_CONSEQUENCE]: {str(e)[:120]}")

    def sweep_promises(self):
        """⏰ Служба сроков: напомнить → предъявить → зафиксировать нарушение."""
        now = time.time()
        if now - float(getattr(self, "_promise_sweep_at", 0)) < self.PROMISE_SWEEP_SEC:
            return 0
        self._promise_sweep_at = now
        self._ensure_promises_db()
        mm = self._mm()
        if mm is None:
            return 0
        acted = 0
        for r in self.active_promises():
            due = r.get("due_at")
            if not due:
                continue
            due = float(due)
            grace = int(r.get("grace_sec", 0) or 0)
            if now < due + grace:
                continue
            over_h = (now - due - grace) / 3600.0
            reminds = int(r.get("remind_count", 0) or 0)
            try:
                mm.execute("goals.db",
                           "UPDATE promises SET last_checked = ? WHERE id = ?",
                           (now, r["id"]))
                if reminds == 0:
                    mm.execute("goals.db",
                               "UPDATE promises SET reminded_at = ?, remind_count = 1 "
                               "WHERE id = ?", (now, r["id"]))
                    acted += 1
                    print(f"🔔 [PROMISE_DUE_NOW]: {r['direction']} — "
                          f"{str(r['text'])[:60]} (просрочено {over_h:.1f} ч)")
                    continue
                limit_h = 6.0 if r.get("due_precision") == "exact" else 48.0
                if over_h >= limit_h or reminds >= 3:
                    self.mark_promise_broken(
                        r["id"], reason=f"просрочено {over_h:.0f} ч")
                    acted += 1
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ [PROMISE_SWEEP]: {str(e)[:120]}")
        if acted:
            self._sync_promises_mirror()
            self.save_all()
        return acted

    def add_promise_given(self, promise_text, to_whom="", to_person="", deadline=None):
        """🤝 Моё обещание → веса. Срок, если назван, ложится на само обещание."""
        return self._add_promise("given", promise_text, to_whom or to_person, deadline)

    def add_promise_received(self, promise_text, from_whom="", from_person="",
                             deadline=None):
        """📥 Его обещание → веса. Без срока — я спрошу, когда именно."""
        return self._add_promise("received", promise_text, from_whom or from_person,
                                 deadline)

    def _add_promise(self, direction, promise_text, target, deadline=None):
        self._ensure_promises_db()
        text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(promise_text or "")).strip()
        if len(text) < 5:
            return None
        mm = self._mm()
        pk = self._promise_person_key(target)
        key = self._fact_key(text)
        pid = None
        if mm is not None:
            try:
                row = mm.fetch_one(
                    "goals.db",
                    "SELECT id FROM promises WHERE direction = ? AND text_key = ? "
                    "AND person_key = ? AND status = 'active' LIMIT 1",
                    (direction, key, pk))
                if row:
                    pid = row["id"]
                    if deadline and deadline.get("ts"):
                        self.set_promise_deadline(pid, deadline)
                    return pid
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ [PROMISE_DEDUP]: {str(e)[:120]}")
        pid = self._new_id("prm")
        now = time.time()
        d = deadline if isinstance(deadline, dict) else {}
        if mm is not None:
            try:
                mm.execute(
                    "goals.db",
                    "INSERT INTO promises (id, direction, person_key, person_name, "
                    "text, text_key, status, created_at, due_at, due_text, "
                    "due_precision, grace_sec) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'active', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                    (pid, direction, pk, str(target or ""), text, key, now,
                     d.get("ts"), str(d.get("human", ""))[:80],
                     d.get("precision", "none"), int(d.get("grace", 0) or 0)))
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ [PROMISE_INSERT]: {str(e)[:140]}")
                return None
        label = ("Я обещала " + str(target)) if direction == "given" \
            else (str(target) + " обещал мне")
        self.add_fact(f"[обещание] {label}: {text}", category="promise")
        self._index_event(f"promise_{direction}:{pid}", self._make_time_link(now))
        self._sync_promises_mirror()
        self.save_all()
        return pid
        
    def get_pending_promises(self):
        """🤝 Незакрытые обещания: мои и собеседника."""
        given = [p for p in self.experience.get("promises_given", [])
                 if isinstance(p, dict) and p.get("status") == "active"]
        received = [p for p in self.experience.get("promises_received", [])
                    if isinstance(p, dict) and p.get("status") == "active"]
        return {"given": given, "received": received}

    def get_active_goals(self):
        """🎯 Активные цели: простые + расширенные, в одном формате."""
        out = [g for g in self.experience.get("goals", [])
               if isinstance(g, dict) and g.get("status") == "active"]
        for gid, g in (self.experience.get("extended_goals", {}) or {}).items():
            if isinstance(g, dict) and g.get("status") == "active":
                out.append({
                    "text": g.get("motivation", ""), "id": gid,
                    "status": "active", "created_at": g.get("created_at", 0),
                })
        return out

    def add_goal(self, text, status="active", deadline=None, priority="normal", source="general"):
        """🎯 Добавляет цель в память (поддерживает дедлайны и приоритеты)."""
        text_clean = text.strip()
        if not text_clean or len(text_clean) < 5:
            return
        
        goal = {
            "text": text_clean,
            "status": status,
            "priority": priority,
            "source": source,
            "created_at": time.time()
        }
        if deadline:
            goal["deadline"] = deadline
            
        if "goals" not in self.experience:
            self.experience["goals"] = []
            
        # Защита от дублей
        for existing in self.experience["goals"]:
            existing_text = existing.get("text", "") if isinstance(existing, dict) else str(existing)
            if existing_text == text_clean:
                print(f"⏭️ [GOAL_SKIP]: Точный дубликат цели пропущен")
                return
                
        self.experience["goals"].append(goal)
        
        # Ограничиваем до 50 целей
        if len(self.experience["goals"]) > 50:
            self.experience["goals"] = self.experience["goals"][-50:]
            
        self.save_all()
        print(f"🎯 [GOAL]: Добавлена цель: {text_clean[:60]}... (статус: {status})")

    def add_insight(self, text, source="general"):
        """💡 Добавляет озарение/инсайт в память."""
        text_clean = text.strip()
        if not text_clean or len(text_clean) < 10:
            return
        insight = {
            "text": text_clean,
            "source": source,
            "timestamp": time.time()
        }
        if "insights" not in self.experience:
            self.experience["insights"] = []
        
        # Защита от дублей
        for existing in self.experience["insights"][-10:]:
            if existing.get("text", "")[:50] == text_clean[:50]:
                return

        self.experience["insights"].append(insight)
        if len(self.experience["insights"]) > 50:
            self.experience["insights"] = self.experience["insights"][-50:]
        self.save_all()
        print(f"💡 [INSIGHT]: {text_clean[:50]}...")

    def _eternal_buffer_load(self):
        """🌊 Хвост восстанавливается из весов, а не теряется при краше."""
        if hasattr(self, "_eternal_buffer"):
            return self._eternal_buffer
        buf = []
        try:
            mm = self._mm()
            if mm is not None:
                row = mm.fetch_one("archive.db",
                                   "SELECT data FROM eternal_buffer WHERE id = 1")
                if row and row.get("data"):
                    loaded = json.loads(row["data"])
                    if isinstance(loaded, list):
                        buf = [p for p in loaded if isinstance(p, dict)]
                        if buf:
                            print(f"🌊 [ETERNAL_BUFFER]: восстановлено {len(buf)} обменов")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ [ETERNAL_BUFFER_LOAD]: {str(e)[:120]}")
        self._eternal_buffer = buf
        return buf

    def _eternal_buffer_save(self):
        try:
            mm = self._mm()
            if mm is None:
                return
            mm.execute(
                "archive.db",
                "INSERT INTO eternal_buffer (id, data, updated_at) VALUES (1, ?, ?) "
                "ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET data=excluded.data, "
                "updated_at=excluded.updated_at",
                (json.dumps(getattr(self, "_eternal_buffer", []), ensure_ascii=False),
                 time.time()))
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ [ETERNAL_BUFFER_SAVE]: {str(e)[:120]}")

    def add_to_short_memory(self, user_text, aiden_text, legacy=None):
        """💬 Обмен → рабочее окно (200) + полная копия в chat_hot.db.
        Вытесненное копится в буфере, который теперь живёт в весах."""
        if not user_text and not aiden_text:
            return
        time_link = self._make_time_link()
        entry = {
            "user": user_text.strip() if user_text else "",
            "aiden": aiden_text.strip() if aiden_text else "",
            "timestamp": time.time(),
            "time_link": time_link,
            "time_of_day": time_link["time_of_day"],
            "day_of_week": time_link["day_of_week"],
        }
        row_id = self._mirror_to_hot_db(entry)
        entry["dialog_id"] = str(row_id) if row_id else self._new_id("dlg")
        if row_id:
            entry["db_rowid"] = row_id
        if not isinstance(self.short_memory, list):
            self.short_memory = []
        self.short_memory.append(entry)
        self._index_event(f"dialog:{entry['dialog_id']}", time_link)

        buf = self._eternal_buffer_load()
        changed = False
        while len(self.short_memory) > self.SHORT_WINDOW:
            buf.append(self.short_memory.pop(0))
            changed = True
        while len(buf) >= self.ETERNAL_BATCH:
            batch = buf[:self.ETERNAL_BATCH]
            del buf[:self.ETERNAL_BATCH]
            self._archive_pairs_to_eternal(batch)
            changed = True
        if changed:
            self._eternal_buffer_save()

        if getattr(self, "cache", None) is not None:
            try:
                self.cache.messages_dirty = True
            except Exception:
                pass
        self.save_all()
        
    def _mirror_to_hot_db(self, entry):
        """🧬 Полная копия обмена в chat_hot.db + векторный индекс.
        Возвращает id строки — он же стабильная ссылка времени на диалог."""
        try:
            from weights.memory import get_memory_manager
            mm = get_memory_manager()
            if mm is None:
                return None
            cursor = mm.execute(
                "chat_hot.db",
                "INSERT INTO chat_hot (user_text, aiden_text, timestamp, time_link, "
                "time_of_day, day_of_week) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (entry["user"], entry["aiden"], entry["timestamp"],
                 json.dumps(entry["time_link"], ensure_ascii=False),
                 entry["time_of_day"], entry["day_of_week"])
            )
            row_id = cursor.lastrowid
            self._hot_insert_counter = getattr(self, "_hot_insert_counter", 0) + 1
            self._index_hot_vector(row_id, entry)
            if self._hot_insert_counter % 100 == 0:
                self._prune_hot_db(mm)
            return row_id
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ [HOT_DB_MIRROR]: {e}")
            return None

    def _index_hot_vector(self, row_id, entry):
        """🔍 Добавляет обмен в векторный индекс chat_hot."""
        try:
            from weights.vectors import get_vector_manager
            vm = get_vector_manager()
            if vm is None or row_id is None:
                return
            # Подключаем эмбеддинги один раз (модель уже загружена в память)
            if vm.embedding_model is None and self.embedding_model is not None:
                vm.set_embedding_model(self.embedding_model, self.tokenizer)
            if vm.embedding_model is None:
                return
            text = (entry.get("user", "") + " " + entry.get("aiden", "")).strip()
            if len(text) < 10:
                return
            index = vm.indices.get("chat_hot")
            if index is None:
                return
            vector = vm._get_embedding(text)
            index.add(vector.detach().cpu(), {
                "db_rowid": row_id,
                "text": text[:200],
                "timestamp": entry.get("timestamp", time.time()),
            })
            # На диск — пачками по 20, не после каждого сообщения
            if self._hot_insert_counter % 20 == 0:
                index.save()
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ [HOT_VECTOR_INDEX]: {e}")

    def search_chat_history(self, query, max_results=5, time_range=None):
        """🗄️ Поиск по ПОЛНОЙ сырой истории диалогов (chat_hot.db).
        SQL по словам + семантика через векторы. Возвращает список обменов."""
        results = {}
        try:
            from weights.memory import get_memory_manager
            mm = get_memory_manager()
            if mm is None:
                return []

            # 1. SQL: ключевые слова (+ фильтр по времени, если задан)
            stop = {"что", "как", "когда", "помнишь", "напомни", "было",
                    "говорили", "обсуждали", "меня", "тебя", "этого"}
            words = [w for w in re.findall(r'\b[а-яёa-z]{4,}\b', (query or "").lower())
                     if w not in stop]
            sql = "SELECT id, user_text, aiden_text, timestamp, time_link FROM chat_hot WHERE 1=1"
            params = []
            if time_range:
                sql += " AND timestamp BETWEEN ? AND ?"
                params.extend([time_range[0], time_range[1]])
            if words:
                cond = " OR ".join(["(LOWER(user_text) LIKE ? OR LOWER(aiden_text) LIKE ?)"] * len(words))
                sql += " AND (" + cond + ")"
                for w in words:
                    params.extend([f"%{w}%", f"%{w}%"])
            elif not time_range:
                return []
            sql += " ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT ?"
            params.append(max_results * 2)
            for row in mm.fetch_all("chat_hot.db", sql, tuple(params)):
                results[row["id"]] = row

            # 2. Семантика: векторы (если подключены)
            if query and len(query) > 10:
                try:
                    from weights.vectors import get_vector_manager
                    vm = get_vector_manager()
                    if vm is not None and vm.embedding_model is not None:
                        index = vm.indices.get("chat_hot")
                        # Разовый бэкфилл: индексируем старые обмены, если индекс пуст
                        if index is not None and len(index) == 0 and not getattr(self, "_hot_backfill_done", False):
                            self._hot_backfill_done = True
                            old_rows = mm.fetch_all(
                                "chat_hot.db",
                                "SELECT id, user_text, aiden_text, timestamp FROM chat_hot "
                                "ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 300"
                            )
                            for r in old_rows:
                                try:
                                    text = (r["user_text"] + " " + r["aiden_text"]).strip()
                                    if len(text) < 10:
                                        continue
                                    vec = vm._get_embedding(text)
                                    index.add(vec.detach().cpu(), {
                                        "db_rowid": r["id"], "text": text[:200],
                                        "timestamp": r["timestamp"],
                                    })
                                except Exception:
                                    continue
                            if len(index) > 0:
                                index.save()
                                print(f"🔍 [HOT_BACKFILL]: Проиндексировано {len(index)} старых обменов")
                        hits = vm.search("chat_hot", query, top_k=max_results, threshold=0.55)
                        ids = [meta.get("db_rowid") for _, meta in hits if meta.get("db_rowid")]
                        if ids:
                            ph = ",".join("?" * len(ids))
                            q2 = f"SELECT id, user_text, aiden_text, timestamp, time_link FROM chat_hot WHERE id IN ({ph})"
                            p2 = list(ids)
                            if time_range:
                                q2 += " AND timestamp BETWEEN ? AND ?"
                                p2.extend([time_range[0], time_range[1]])
                            for row in mm.fetch_all("chat_hot.db", q2, tuple(p2)):
                                results[row["id"]] = row
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"⚠️ [HOT_SEMANTIC]: {e}")

            rows = sorted(results.values(), key=lambda r: r.get("timestamp", 0), reverse=True)
            return rows[:max_results]
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ [HOT_SEARCH_ERR]: {e}")
            return []

    def get_chat_history_context(self, query, time_range=None, max_results=5):
        """🗄️ Контекст из полной истории диалогов (дословные обмены для промпта)."""
        rows = self.search_chat_history(query, max_results=max_results, time_range=time_range)
        if not rows:
            return ""
        NL = chr(10)
        lines = ["🗄️ ПОЛНАЯ ИСТОРИЯ ДИАЛОГОВ (дословно, из весов):"]
        for r in rows:
            ts = r.get("timestamp", 0)
            when = time.strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M", time.localtime(ts)) if ts else "?"
            u = str(r.get("user_text", ""))[:150]
            a = str(r.get("aiden_text", ""))[:150]
            lines.append(f"  • [{when}] Собеседник: {u}")
            if a:
                lines.append(f"    Эйден: {a}")
        lines.append("Это точные прошлые реплики. Опирайся на них, отвечая о прошлом.")
        return NL.join(lines) + NL

    def _prune_hot_db(self, mm=None):
        """🗑️ Лимит истории: удаляем старые обмены И их векторы.
        Раньше индекс копил ссылки на удалённые строки и врал при поиске."""
        try:
            from weights.memory import get_memory_manager
            mm = mm or get_memory_manager()
            if mm is None:
                return
            pc = mm.fetch_one("chat_hot.db", "PRAGMA page_count")
            ps = mm.fetch_one("chat_hot.db", "PRAGMA page_size")
            size_mb = (list(pc.values())[0] * list(ps.values())[0]) / (1024 * 1024) \
                if pc and ps else 0
            if size_mb <= self.HOT_DB_MAX_MB:
                return
            cnt = mm.fetch_one("chat_hot.db", "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM chat_hot")
            to_delete = max(1, int((cnt["n"] if cnt else 0) * 0.1))
            rows = mm.fetch_all(
                "chat_hot.db",
                "SELECT id FROM chat_hot ORDER BY timestamp ASC LIMIT ?",
                (to_delete,))
            dead = [int(r["id"]) for r in rows if r.get("id") is not None]
            if not dead:
                return
            ph = ",".join("?" * len(dead))
            mm.execute("chat_hot.db",
                       f"DELETE FROM chat_hot WHERE id IN ({ph})", tuple(dead))
            removed_vec = 0
            try:
                from weights.vectors import get_vector_manager
                vm = get_vector_manager()
                idx = vm.indices.get("chat_hot") if vm is not None else None
                if idx is not None and len(idx) > 0:
                    dead_set = set(dead)
                    positions = [i for i, m in enumerate(idx.metadata)
                                 if m.get("db_rowid") in dead_set]
                    for i in sorted(positions, reverse=True):
                        idx.remove(i)
                        removed_vec += 1
                    if removed_vec:
                        idx.save()
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ [HOT_PRUNE_VECTORS]: {str(e)[:120]}")
            print(f"🗑️ [HOT_DB_PRUNE]: {size_mb:.0f} МБ > {self.HOT_DB_MAX_MB} МБ → "
                  f"удалено {len(dead)} обменов и {removed_vec} векторов")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ [HOT_DB_PRUNE_ERR]: {e}")
    def _archive_pairs_to_eternal(self, pairs):
        """📚 Пачка обменов → оглавление в вечной памяти (JSON-кэш + eternal.db).
        Полные тексты остаются в chat_hot.db — ничего не теряется."""
        if not pairs:
            return
        last_ts = pairs[-1].get("timestamp", time.time())
        parts = []
        for p in pairs:
            u = str(p.get("user", ""))[:80]
            a = str(p.get("aiden", ""))[:80]
            parts.append(f"{u} → {a}")
        summary = " | ".join(parts)[:600]
        period = (f"{time.strftime('%d.%m', time.localtime(pairs[0].get('timestamp', last_ts)))} - "
                  f"{time.strftime('%d.%m', time.localtime(last_ts))}")
        if "eternal_memory" not in self.experience:
            self.experience["eternal_memory"] = []
        self.experience["eternal_memory"].append({
            "summary": summary,
            "timestamp": last_ts,
            "messages_compressed": len(pairs),
            "period": period,
            "time_link": pairs[-1].get("time_link") or self._make_time_link(last_ts)
        })
        # JSON — только рабочее оглавление (500), полная вечная память — в весах (400 МБ)
        if len(self.experience["eternal_memory"]) > 500:
            self.experience["eternal_memory"] = self.experience["eternal_memory"][-500:]
        try:
            from weights.memory import get_memory_manager
            mm = get_memory_manager()
            if mm:
                mm.execute(
                    "eternal.db",
                    "INSERT INTO eternal (summary, period, messages_compressed, timestamp, shutdown_compressed) "
                    "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 0)",
                    (summary, period, len(pairs), last_ts)
                )
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ [ETERNAL_DB]: {e}")
        print(f"📚 [ETERNAL]: {len(pairs)} обменов → оглавление вечной памяти (полные тексты в chat_hot.db)")   
        
    def shutdown_compress(self, legacy=None):
        """🛑 При выключении: сырая история УЖЕ в chat_hot.db.
        Дописываем хвост буфера (в т.ч. восстановленный после краша)."""
        saved = 0
        buf = self._eternal_buffer_load()
        if buf:
            self._archive_pairs_to_eternal(buf)
            saved += len(buf)
            self._eternal_buffer = []
            self._eternal_buffer_save()

        long_term = self.experience.get("long_term_memory", [])
        if long_term:
            last_ts = long_term[-1].get("timestamp", time.time())
            summary = " | ".join(str(i.get("summary", ""))[:60] for i in long_term)[:600]
            self.experience.setdefault("eternal_memory", []).append({
                "summary": summary, "timestamp": last_ts,
                "messages_compressed": len(long_term), "period": "legacy-архив",
                "shutdown_compressed": True,
            })
            try:
                mm = self._mm()
                if mm:
                    mm.execute(
                        "eternal.db",
                        "INSERT INTO eternal (summary, period, messages_compressed, "
                        "timestamp, shutdown_compressed) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 1)",
                        (summary, "legacy-архив", len(long_term), last_ts))
            except Exception:
                pass
            self.experience["long_term_memory"] = []
            saved += len(long_term)

        try:
            vm = self._vm()
            if vm is not None:
                for name in ("chat_hot", "facts"):
                    idx = vm.indices.get(name)
                    if idx is not None and len(idx) > 0:
                        idx.save()
        except Exception:
            pass

        self.save_all(force=True)
        if saved:
            print(f"💾 [SHUTDOWN]: {saved} записей доведено до вечной памяти.")
        return saved
        
    def get_memory_cascade_context(self, user_text, max_long=8, max_eternal=5):
        """
        🌊 Возвращает контекст из короткой, долгосрочной и вечной памяти.
        🔧 v3.1: Ищет и в КОРОТКОЙ памяти (последние 10 сообщений),
        чтобы вчерашние диалоги не терялись до перелива в долгосрочную.
        """
        parts = []
        now = time.time()

        # 🕐 ПАРСИМ ВРЕМЕННОЙ ЗАПРОС
        time_start, time_end, time_desc = self._parse_time_reference(user_text)
        is_memory_q = self._is_memory_question(user_text)

        # ═══ КОРОТКАЯ ПАМЯТЬ (последние 10 сообщений целиком) ═══
        if self.short_memory:
            relevant_short = []

            # 🕐 РЕЖИМ 1: ВРЕМЕННОЙ ЗАПРОС
            if time_start and time_end:
                for msg in self.short_memory:
                    ts = msg.get("timestamp", 0)
                    if time_start <= ts <= time_end:
                        relevant_short.append(msg)
            # 🕐 РЕЖИМ 2: ОБЫЧНЫЙ ЗАПРОС — берём последние
            else:
                relevant_short = self.short_memory[-max_long:]

            if relevant_short:
                parts.append("💬 ПОСЛЕДНИЕ СООБЩЕНИЯ (короткая память):")
                if time_start:
                    parts.append(f"  🔎 Ищу за период: {time_desc}")
                for msg in relevant_short[-max_long:]:
                    ts = msg.get("timestamp", 0)
                    age_hours = (now - ts) / 3600 if ts > 0 else 0

                    # ЯВНЫЙ ЯКОРЬ ВРЕМЕНИ
                    if age_hours < 1:
                        age_marker = f"[{int(age_hours*60)} мин назад]"
                    elif age_hours < 24:
                        age_marker = f"[{int(age_hours)} ч назад — СЕГОДНЯ]"
                    elif age_hours < 48:
                        age_marker = f"[{int(age_hours)} ч назад — ВЧЕРА]"
                    else:
                        days = int(age_hours / 24)
                        age_marker = f"[{days} дн назад]"

                    user_part = str(msg.get("user", ""))[:120]
                    aiden_part = str(msg.get("aiden", ""))[:120]
                    parts.append(f"  • {age_marker} Собеседник: {user_part}")
                    if aiden_part:
                        parts.append(f"    Эйден: {aiden_part}")

        # ═══ ДОЛГОСРОЧНАЯ ПАМЯТЬ ═══
        long_term = self.experience.get("long_term_memory", [])
        if long_term:
            relevant = []

            # 🕐 РЕЖИМ 1: ВРЕМЕННОЙ ЗАПРОС (ищем по timestamp)
            if time_start and time_end:
                for item in long_term:
                    ts = item.get("timestamp", 0)
                    if ts < 1:
                        age_hours = item.get("age_hours", 0)
                        ts = now - (age_hours * 3600) if age_hours else 0
                    if time_start <= ts <= time_end:
                        if "age_hours" not in item or item["age_hours"] == 0:
                            item["age_hours"] = round((now - ts) / 3600, 1)
                        relevant.append(item)
                relevant.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("timestamp", 0))

            # 🕐 РЕЖИМ 2: ОБЫЧНЫЙ ЗАПРОС
            else:
                user_lower = user_text.lower()
                words = re.findall(r'\b[а-яёa-z]{4,}\b', user_lower)
                recent = long_term[-max_long:]
                for item in long_term[:-max_long]:
                    summary_lower = item.get("summary", "").lower()
                    score = sum(1 for w in words if w in summary_lower)
                    if score >= 2:
                        relevant.append(item)
                relevant = relevant[-3:]
                relevant = relevant + recent

            if relevant:
                parts.append(f"📦 ДОЛГОСРОЧНАЯ ПАМЯТЬ (сжатые диалоги):")
                if time_start:
                    parts.append(f"  🔎 Ищу за период: {time_desc}")
                for item in relevant[:max_long]:
                    summary = item.get("summary", "")
                    ts = item.get("timestamp", 0)
                    age_hours = item.get("age_hours", 0)
                    if not age_hours and ts > 0:
                        age_hours = (now - ts) / 3600

                    if age_hours < 1:
                        age_marker = f"[{int(age_hours*60)} мин назад]"
                    elif age_hours < 24:
                        age_marker = f"[{int(age_hours)} ч назад — СЕГОДНЯ]"
                    elif age_hours < 48:
                        age_marker = f"[{int(age_hours)} ч назад — ВЧЕРА]"
                    else:
                        days = int(age_hours / 24)
                        age_marker = f"[{days} дн назад]"

                    if not summary.startswith("["):
                        summary = f"{age_marker} {summary}"
                    parts.append(f"  • {summary}")

        # ═══ ВЕЧНАЯ ПАМЯТЬ ═══
        eternal = self.experience.get("eternal_memory", [])
        if eternal:
            relevant_eternal = []

            if time_start and time_end:
                for item in eternal:
                    ts = item.get("timestamp", 0)
                    period = item.get("period", "")
                    if time_start <= ts <= time_end:
                        relevant_eternal.append(item)
                    elif period and time_desc:
                        period_lower = period.lower()
                        if any(w in period_lower for w in time_desc.lower().split()):
                            relevant_eternal.append(item)
                relevant_eternal = relevant_eternal[:max_eternal]
            else:
                relevant_eternal = eternal[-max_eternal:]

            if relevant_eternal:
                parts.append("📚 ВЕЧНАЯ ПАМЯТЬ (давнее прошлое, как главы книги):")
                for item in relevant_eternal:
                    period = item.get("period", "")
                    summary = item.get("summary", "")
                    if period:
                        parts.append(f"  • [{period}] {summary}")
                    else:
                        parts.append(f"  • {summary}")

        if parts:
            parts.append("")
            parts.append(f"⏰ СЕЙЧАС: {time.strftime('%H:%M, %d.%m.%Y')} — ВСЁ ЧТО ВЫШЕ БЫЛО В ПРОШЛОМ.")
            return "\n".join(parts) + "\n"
        return ""
        
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    # 🕐 ПАРСЕР ВРЕМЕННЫХ ЗАПРОСОВ
    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    @staticmethod
    def _parse_time_reference(text):
        """
        🕐 Парсит временные ссылки в запросе пользователя.
        Возвращает: (time_start, time_end, description) в timestamp ИЛИ (None, None, None)
        
        Поддерживает:
        - "вчера", "вчера утром/днём/вечером/ночью"
        - "сегодня утром/днём/вечером"
        - "позавчера"
        - "N часов/минут/дней назад"
        - "на прошлой неделе", "неделю назад"
        - "в понедельник/вторник/..." (последний такой день)
        """
        import re as _re
        from datetime import datetime, timedelta
        
        text_lower = text.lower().strip()
        now = time.time()
        now_dt = datetime.now()
        
        # ━━━ "вчера" ━━━
        if "вчера" in text_lower:
            yesterday = now_dt - timedelta(days=1)
            day_start = yesterday.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
            day_end = day_start + timedelta(days=1)
            
            # Уточнение по времени суток
            if any(w in text_lower for w in ["утром", "утро"]):
                start = day_start.replace(hour=6)
                end = day_start.replace(hour=12)
                desc = "вчера утром (06:00-12:00)"
            elif any(w in text_lower for w in ["днём", "день", "днем"]):
                start = day_start.replace(hour=10)
                end = day_start.replace(hour=18)
                desc = "вчера днём (10:00-18:00)"
            elif any(w in text_lower for w in ["вечером", "вечер"]):
                start = day_start.replace(hour=17)
                end = day_start.replace(hour=23, minute=59)
                desc = "вчера вечером (17:00-23:59)"
            elif any(w in text_lower for w in ["ночью", "ночь"]):
                start = day_start.replace(hour=0)
                end = day_start.replace(hour=6)
                desc = "вчера ночью (00:00-06:00)"
            else:
                start = day_start
                end = day_end
                desc = "вчера (весь день)"
            
            return start.timestamp(), end.timestamp(), desc
        
        # ━━━ "сегодня" + время суток ━━━
        if "сегодня" in text_lower:
            day_start = now_dt.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
            if any(w in text_lower for w in ["утром", "утро"]):
                start = day_start.replace(hour=6)
                end = day_start.replace(hour=12)
                desc = "сегодня утром (06:00-12:00)"
            elif any(w in text_lower for w in ["днём", "день", "днем"]):
                start = day_start.replace(hour=10)
                end = min(day_start.replace(hour=18), now_dt).replace(microsecond=0)
                desc = "сегодня днём (10:00-сейчас)"
            elif any(w in text_lower for w in ["вечером", "вечер"]):
                start = day_start.replace(hour=17)
                end = min(day_start.replace(hour=23, minute=59), now_dt)
                desc = "сегодня вечером (17:00-сейчас)"
            else:
                start = day_start
                end = now_dt
                desc = "сегодня"
            return start.timestamp(), end.timestamp(), desc
        
        # ━━━ "позавчера" ━━━
        if "позавчера" in text_lower:
            day_before = now_dt - timedelta(days=2)
            day_start = day_before.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
            day_end = day_start + timedelta(days=1)
            return day_start.timestamp(), day_end.timestamp(), "позавчера (весь день)"
        
        # ━━━ "N часов/минут/дней назад" ━━━
        ago_match = _re.search(
            r'(\d+)\s*(час|минут|мин|день|дн|секунд|сек)\w*\s*назад',
            text_lower
        )
        if ago_match:
            amount = int(ago_match.group(1))
            unit = ago_match.group(2)
            if unit.startswith("час"):
                seconds = amount * 3600
                desc = f"{amount} ч назад"
            elif unit.startswith("мин"):
                seconds = amount * 60
                desc = f"{amount} мин назад"
            elif unit.startswith("день") or unit.startswith("дн"):
                seconds = amount * 86400
                desc = f"{amount} дн назад"
            elif unit.startswith("сек"):
                seconds = amount
                desc = f"{amount} сек назад"
            else:
                return None, None, None
            start = now - seconds
            return start, now, desc
        
        # ━━━ "на прошлой неделе" / "неделю назад" ━━━
        if "недел" in text_lower and ("прошл" in text_lower or "назад" in text_lower):
            start = now - 7 * 86400
            return start, now, "последняя неделя"
        
        # ━━━ Дни недели: "в понедельник", "во вторник" ━━━
        weekdays = {
            "понедельник": 0, "вторник": 1, "среда": 2, "четверг": 3,
            "пятница": 4, "суббота": 5, "воскресенье": 6
        }
        for day_name, day_num in weekdays.items():
            if day_name in text_lower:
                current_weekday = now_dt.weekday()
                days_back = (current_weekday - day_num) % 7
                if days_back == 0:
                    days_back = 7  # Если сегодня этот день — берём прошлую неделю
                target_day = now_dt - timedelta(days=days_back)
                day_start = target_day.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
                day_end = day_start + timedelta(days=1)
                return day_start.timestamp(), day_end.timestamp(), f"в {day_name}"
        
        # ━━━ "давно", "раньше" (широкий диапазон) ━━━
        if any(w in text_lower for w in ["давно", "раньше", "как-то", "помнишь"]):
            start = now - 30 * 86400  # последние 30 дней
            return start, now - 86400, "давно (последний месяц, не сегодня)"
        
        return None, None, None
    
    @staticmethod
    def _is_memory_question(text):
        """
        🧠 Определяет, спрашивает ли пользователь о ПРОШЛЫХ РАЗГОВОРАХ/СОБЫТИЯХ.
        Если да — каскад памяти должен быть ПЕРВИЧНЫМ, а не факты.
        """
        text_lower = text.lower().strip()
        memory_triggers = [
            # Прямые вопросы о памяти
            "о чём мы", "о чем мы", "что мы обсуждали", "что мы говорили",
            "мы разговаривали", "мы обсуждали", "мы говорили",
            "что было", "что ты помнишь", "ты помнишь",
            "напомни", "напомни мне",
            "когда мы", "где мы", "как мы",
            # Временные маркеры
            "вчера", "сегодня утром", "сегодня днём", "сегодня вечером",
            "позавчера", "на прошлой неделе", "неделю назад",
            "час назад", "часа назад", "минут назад",
            "в понедельник", "во вторник", "в среду", "в четверг",
            "в пятницу", "в субботу", "в воскресенье",
            "давно", "раньше",
            # Вопросы о событиях
            "помнишь как", "помнишь что", "помнишь когда",
            "что случилось", "что произошло",
        ]
        return any(trigger in text_lower for trigger in memory_triggers)      

    def load_full_context(self, user_text, current_chemistry=None):
        """🧠 Контекст памяти = умное вспоминание по теме, а не свалка всего.
        Бюджет считается под окно ядра, а не «сколько влезет на диск»."""
        if current_chemistry:
            self._chem_ref = dict(current_chemistry)
        return self.recall(user_text, current_chemistry)["text"]
